scene.headline: We saw the circuit
metadata: TWO LETTERS TO BORELLI · THE LUNG OF A FROG

counter.label: years after Ibn al-Nafis reasoned the passages must exist

citations.title: De pulmonibus observationes anatomicae
citations.note: The two letters to Borelli: the injections in a dog's lung in the first, the frog and the way to see it in the second; the reading's translations are ours

citations.title: Marcello Malpighi, De pulmonibus observationes anatomicae: figures I and II, the lungs of a frog
citations.container: Marcello Malpighi, De pulmonibus observationes anatomicae (Bologna, 1661); Wellcome Collection, via Wikimedia Commons

connections.why: The network Malpighi saw in a frog's lung is the passage between the pulmonary artery and the pulmonary vein that Ibn al-Nafis reasoned must exist, some four hundred years before anyone could see it.
